params.caption: 🎮 Slay the Spire 2 adds its first new character: The Fool Mega Crit's v0.113.0 beta brings The Fool, a bow-wielding musician and the first new hero of Early Access, plus two modes: Blitz, a fast map-free run where Gold doesn't matter, and Dread, a brutal challenge that demands Ascension on every character. The studio expects many changes before The Fool reaches the main branch. Opt in via Steam's "public-beta" branch. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 00:08 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 🃏 React if you're jumping into the beta · 💬 Blitz or Dread first? #SlayTheSpire2 #MegaCrit #Roguelike #GamingNews
